description: The donut chart, titled “Task Type,” visually represents the distribution of tasks related to generative AI in journalism as discussed in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” It is divided into three segments: the largest, colored in red, corresponds to “Article generation” and accounts for 82.9% of the total; the second largest, in blue, represents “Article editing” at 14.6%; and a very small yellow segment, labeled with a grayed-out placeholder, suggests a third, minor category that is not fully legible in the image. The chart emphasizes the dominance of article generation over other tasks, with the red segment visually dominating the ring. The central white space contains the bolded label “Task Type,” reinforcing the chart’s focus on categorizing journalistic activities. No legend is present, and percentages are displayed directly adjacent to their respective segments. The visual hierarchy clearly indicates that article generation is the primary use case studied.
